title: 의료ㆍ요양 등 지역 돌봄의 통합지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.text_en: Ministry of Health and Welfare ( Integrated Care Policy Division ), 044-202-3584, 3585

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「의료ㆍ요양 등 지역 돌봄의 통합지원에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Integrated Support for Community Care, such as Medical Care and Long-term Care, and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(통합지원 기본계획의 수립ㆍ시행) ① 보건복지부장관은 「의료ㆍ요양 등 지역 돌봄의 통합지원에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제5조제1항에 따라 통합지원 기본계획(이하 “기본계획”이라 한다)을 수립 하거나 법 제5조제4항 후단에 따라 변경하려는 경우 시장(「제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법」 제11조제1항에 따른 행정시장을 포함한다. 이하 같다)ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말하며, 이하 “시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장”이라 한다)의 의견을 들어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Establishment and Implementation of the Basic Plan for Integrated Support) ① When the Minister of Health and Welfare intends to establish a basic plan for integrated support (hereinafter referred to as the “basic plan”) pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Integrated Support for Community Care, Including Medical Care and Long-Term Care (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), or amend it pursuant to the latter part of Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Act, the Minister shall hear the opinions of Mayors (including administrative mayors pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Development of Free International City; hereinafter the same applies), County Governors, and heads of Gu (meaning heads of autonomous Gus; hereinafter referred to as “Mayors, County Governors, and heads of Gu”).

rows.source_ko: ② 보건복지부장관은 법 제5조제4항에 따라 기본계획이 확정된 경우에는 지체 없이 관계 중앙행정기관의 장 및 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다) 및 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 그 내용을 알리고, 보건복지부의 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When a basic plan is finalized pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Act, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall, without delay, notify the heads of relevant central administrative agencies, mayors of special cities, metropolitan cities, special autonomous cities, governors of provinces and special autonomous provinces (hereinafter referred to as “city/provincial governors”), and mayors, county heads, and district heads of the contents thereof, and post it on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Health and Welfare.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(지역계획의 수립ㆍ시행) ① 시ㆍ도지사 및 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제6조제1항에 따른 통합지원 지역계획(이하 “지역계획”이라 한다)을 수립할 때에는 「사회보장급여의 이용ㆍ제공 및 수급권자 발굴에 관한 법률」 제35조에 따른 지역사회보장계획과 연계되도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Establishment and Implementation of Regional Plans) ① When a Mayor/Provincial Governor or a Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu establishes a regional plan for integrated support (hereinafter referred to as the “regional plan”) pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the plan shall be linked to the community social security plan under Article 35 of the Act on the Use and Provision of Social Security Benefits and the Identification of Beneficiaries.

rows.source_ko: ② 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 지역주민 등 이해관계인의 의견을 듣고 지역계획을 수립한 후 법 제20조에 따른 시ㆍ군ㆍ구 통합지원협의체의 심의를 거쳐 확정하고, 이를 매년 11월 30일까지 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu shall establish a regional plan after hearing the opinions of interested parties, such as local residents, finalize it through deliberation by the City/County/Gu Integrated Support Council under Article 20 of the Act, and submit it to the Mayor/Provincial Governor by November 30 of each year.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시ㆍ도지사는 제2항에 따라 제출받은 시ㆍ군ㆍ구 지역계획을 지원하는 내용을 포함하는 해당 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도(이하 “시ㆍ도”라 한다)의 지역계획을 수립하여 법 제20조에 따른 시ㆍ도 통합지원협의체의 심의를 거쳐 확정하고, 매년 12월 31일까지 보건복지부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ A Mayor/Provincial Governor shall establish a regional plan for the relevant Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Province, or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as a “City/Province”), incorporating the contents of the regional plans for cities, counties, and Gus submitted pursuant to Paragraph 2, finalize it after deliberation by the City/Province Integrated Support Council under Article 20 of the Act, and submit it to the Minister of Health and Welfare by December 31 of each year.

rows.source_ko: ④ 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 지역계획을 수립한 후 기본계획이 변경된 경우에는 소관 지역계획에 그 내용을 반영하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ If the basic plan is changed after the regional plan has been established, the mayor, county head, or district head shall reflect the changes in the relevant regional plan.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(지역계획 조정) ① 보건복지부장관은 법 제6조제3항에 따라 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 해당 시ㆍ도지사에게 지역계획의 조정을 권고할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Coordination of Regional Plans) ① Pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Act, the Minister of Health and Welfare may recommend that the relevant Mayor/Provincial Governor coordinate a regional plan in any of the following cases:

rows.source_ko: 1. 시ㆍ도 지역계획의 내용이 법령을 위반할 우려가 있는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where there is a risk that the content of the city or provincial regional plan may violate laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 2. 시ㆍ도 지역계획의 내용이 기본계획 또는 보건복지 분야 정부 시책과 부합하지 않는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where the content of the city/province regional plan does not conform to the basic plan or government policies in the health and welfare sector

rows.source_ko: 3. 시ㆍ도 간 지역계획의 내용에 현저한 불균형이 있는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where there is a significant imbalance in the content of regional plans between cities and provinces

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 시ㆍ도 지역계획의 조정이 필요하다고 보건복지부장관이 인정하는 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Other cases where the Minister of Health and Welfare deems it necessary to coordinate city or provincial regional plans

rows.source_ko: ② 시ㆍ도지사는 법 제6조제3항에 따라 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 관할 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 해당 지역계획의 조정을 권고할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Act, the competent Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu may recommend coordination of the relevant regional plan in any of the following cases.

rows.source_ko: 1. 보건복지부장관이 지역계획의 조정을 권고한 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where the Minister of Health and Welfare has recommended the adjustment of a regional plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 관할 시ㆍ군ㆍ구 지역계획이 시ㆍ도 지역계획과 부합하지 않는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where the regional plan of the competent city, county, or district does not conform to the regional plan of the city or province

rows.source_ko: 3. 관할 시ㆍ군ㆍ구 지역계획 간 내용에 현저한 불균형이 있는 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where there is a significant imbalance in content among the regional plans of the competent city, county, or district

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 시ㆍ군ㆍ구 지역계획의 조정이 필요하다고 시ㆍ도지사가 인정하는 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Other cases where the Mayor or Provincial Governor deems it necessary to coordinate the regional plans of cities, counties, or districts.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 또는 제2항에 따라 지역계획의 조정을 권고받은 시ㆍ도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 조정 내용을 반영하고 그 결과를 보건복지부장관 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ A Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu who has received a recommendation to coordinate a regional plan pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2 shall reflect the recommended changes and submit the results to the Minister of Health and Welfare or the Mayor/Provincial Governor.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(실태조사의 내용ㆍ방법 등) ① 법 제7조제1항에 따른 통합지원 실태조사에는 다음 각 호의 내용이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Contents and Methods of Fact-Finding Survey, etc.) ① The fact-finding survey of integrated support pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall include the contents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 지역별 통합지원 전달체계(법 제20조에 따른 통합지원협의체 및 법 제21조에 따른 지역별 통합지원 전담조직 등을 포함한다)의 구성ㆍ인력 등 운영 현황
rows.text_en: 1. Operational status, including composition and personnel, of the regional integrated support delivery system ( including the Integrated Support Council pursuant to Article 20 of the Act and the regional integrated support dedicated organizations pursuant to Article 21 of the Act ).

rows.source_ko: 2. 지역별 통합지원 서비스 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Status of Integrated Support Services by Region

rows.source_ko: 3. 통합지원 대상자별 및 서비스 영역별 이용 현황
rows.text_en: 3. Usage Status by Integrated Support Beneficiary and Service Area

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 보건복지부장관이 기본계획의 수립 및 통합지원 정책 운영을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Health and Welfare for the establishment of the basic plan and the operation of integrated support policies

rows.source_ko: ② 보건복지부장관은 제1항에 따른 실태조사의 내용 중 일부를 다음 각 호의 조사에 반영하여 실시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare may conduct the investigations under each of the following subparagraphs by reflecting some of the contents of the fact-finding survey under Paragraph 1 in them.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「노인복지법」 제5조에 따른 노인실태조사
rows.text_en: 1. Survey on the Status of the Elderly pursuant to Article 5 of the Elderly Welfare Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「노인장기요양보험법」 제6조의2에 따른 실태조사
rows.text_en: 2. Fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 6-2 of the Long-term Care Insurance Act for the Elderly

rows.source_ko: 3. 「사회보장급여의 이용ㆍ제공 및 수급권자 발굴에 관한 법률」 제35조에 따른 지역사회보장조사
rows.text_en: 3. Community social security investigation pursuant to Article 35 of the Act on the Use and Provision of Social Security Benefits and the Identification of Beneficiaries

rows.source_ko: 4. 「장애인복지법」 제31조에 따른 실태조사
rows.text_en: 4. Fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 31 of the Act on Welfare of Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: ③ 보건복지부장관은 통합지원 실태조사를 전문연구기관ㆍ단체나 관계 전문가에게 의뢰하여 실시할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare may commission a survey on the status of integrated support to specialized research institutions, organizations, or relevant experts.

rows.source_ko: ④ 보건복지부장관은 법 제7조제1항에 따라 실태조사 결과를 공표하려는 경우에는 보건복지부의 인터넷 홈페이지에 게시하는 방법으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ If the Minister of Health and Welfare intends to publish the results of a fact-finding survey pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall do so by posting them on the internet homepage of the Ministry of Health and Welfare.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(추진성과의 평가 등) ① 법 제9조제1항에 따라 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 및 시ㆍ도지사는 해당 연도 지역계획에 따른 추진성과를 매년 12월 31일까지 보건복지부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Evaluation of Implementation Results, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act, Mayors/Provincial Governors and Mayors, County Governors, and heads of Gu shall submit the implementation results of the regional plan for the relevant year to the Minister of Health and Welfare by December 31 of each year.

rows.source_ko: ② 보건복지부장관은 제1항에 따라 제출받은 지역계획의 추진성과를 다음 각 호의 사항을 고려하여 보건복지부장관이 정하는 기준에 따라 평가해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare shall evaluate the performance results of the regional plans submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1 in accordance with the standards determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare, taking into consideration the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 기본계획과의 부합성
rows.text_en: 1. Consistency with the Master Plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 지역계획 내용의 충실성
rows.text_en: 2. Completeness of the Regional Plan Content

rows.source_ko: 3. 시행과정의 적정성
rows.text_en: 3. Appropriateness of the implementation process

rows.source_ko: 4. 시행결과의 목표달성도
rows.text_en: 4. Achievement of objectives from implementation results

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 보건복지부장관이 지역계획 추진성과를 평가하기 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Health and Welfare to evaluate the performance of regional plans

rows.source_ko: ③ 보건복지부장관은 지역계획 추진성과에 대한 평가를 효율적으로 수행하기 위하여 매년 10월 31일까지 평가의 기준 및 방법 등이 포함된 평가계획을 수립하여 시ㆍ도지사 및 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ To efficiently evaluate the implementation results of regional plans, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall establish an evaluation plan, including evaluation criteria and methods, by October 31 of each year and notify the Mayors/Provincial Governors and the Mayors, County Governors, and heads of Gu.

rows.source_ko: ④ 보건복지부장관은 제1항에 따라 제출받은 지역계획 추진성과에 대한 평가 결과를 시ㆍ도지사 및 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통보하고, 보건복지부의 인터넷 홈페이지 등을 이용하여 공표할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Health and Welfare may notify the governors of cities and provinces and mayors, county heads, and district heads of the results of the evaluation of the performance of regional plans submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1, and may publish them using the Ministry of Health and Welfare’s website, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 시ㆍ도지사 및 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 지역계획 추진성과에 대한 평가 결과를 지역계획에 반영하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The mayor, county head, or district head shall reflect the evaluation results of the performance of the regional plan in the regional plan.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(통합지원의 신청) ① 법 제10조제1항에서 “통합지원이 필요한 자와 그 가족 및 통합지원 관련기관의 업무담당자 등 보건복지부령으로 정하는 자”란 다음 각 호의 자를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Integrated Support) ① The term “persons requiring integrated support, their families, and officials in charge of integrated support-related institutions, etc., as prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” in Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act means any of the following persons:

rows.source_ko: 1. 통합지원이 필요한 사람 본인
rows.text_en: 1. The person requiring integrated support

rows.source_ko: 2. 통합지원이 필요한 사람의 배우자, 부모 및 자녀 등 친족
rows.text_en: 2. Relatives of a person requiring integrated support, such as spouse, parents, and children

rows.source_ko: 3. 통합지원이 필요한 사람의 후견인
rows.text_en: 3. Guardian of a person requiring integrated support

rows.source_ko: 4. 제1호부터 제3호까지의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자의 동의를 받은 사람으로서 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 통합지원 관련기관 등의 업무 담당자
rows.text_en: 4. A person who has obtained the consent of any of the persons falling under Subparagraphs 1 through 3, and who is a staff member of an integrated support-related institution, etc., falling under any of the following subparagraphs

rows.source_ko: 가. 법 제11조에 따라 퇴원 또는 퇴소를 통보하는 의료기관 또는 시설
rows.text_en: a. Medical institutions or facilities notifying of discharge or release pursuant to Article 11 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 「노인복지법」 제38조에 따른 재가노인복지시설
rows.text_en: B. Home-based elderly welfare facilities pursuant to Article 38 of the Elderly Welfare Act

rows.source_ko: 다. 「노인장기요양보험법」 제23조제1항제1호 또는 제2호에 따른 재가급여 또는 시설급여를 제공하는 시설
rows.text_en: C. Facilities providing home care benefits or institutional care benefits pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraph 1 or 2 of the Long-term Care Insurance Act for the Elderly

rows.source_ko: 라. 「장애인 건강권 및 의료접근성 보장에 관한 법률」 제20조에 따른 지역장애인보건의료센터로 지정된 의료기관
rows.text_en: D. Medical institutions designated as Regional Health and Medical Centers for Persons with Disabilities pursuant to Article 20 of the Act on Guaranteeing Health Rights and Medical Accessibility for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 마. 「장애인복지법 시행규칙」 별표 4 제2호가목에 따른 장애인복지관
rows.text_en: E. Welfare centers for persons with disabilities pursuant to Item 2, Subparagraph A of Annex 4 of the Enforcement Rules of the Welfare Act for Persons with Disabilities

rows.source_ko: 바. 그 밖에 보건복지부장관이 필요하다고 인정하는 자
rows.text_en: f. Other persons deemed necessary by the Minister of Health and Welfare

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항 각 호에 해당하는 자(이하 “신청인”이라 한다)가 법 제10조제1항에 따라 통합지원을 신청하려는 경우에는 별지 제1호서식의 통합지원 신청서에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 관할 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② A person falling under any of the subparagraphs of Paragraph 1 (hereinafter referred to as the “Applicant”) who intends to apply for integrated support pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for integrated support in Form No. 1 attached hereto to the competent Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu, together with the documents specified in the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제1항제2호에 따른 친족의 경우: 다음 각 목의 서류
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of relatives under Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2: the documents of each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 친족의 주민등록증 등 신분증 사본(신분증 제시로 갈음할 수 있다)
rows.text_en: a. Copy of a relative's identification card, such as a resident registration card (presentation of an identification card may be substituted)

rows.source_ko: 나. 제적등본(가족관계기록사항에 관한 증명서를 통해 통합지원이 필요한 사람과의 관계를 확인할 수 없는 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: B. Certified Copy of Family Register (limited to cases where the relationship with the person requiring integrated support cannot be confirmed through a Certificate of Family Relations Records)

rows.source_ko: 2. 제1항제3호에 따른 후견인의 경우: 다음 각 목의 서류
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of a guardian pursuant to Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3: the documents of each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 후견인의 주민등록증 등 신분증 사본(신분증 제시로 갈음할 수 있다)
rows.text_en: a. Copy of the guardian's identification card, such as a resident registration card (presentation of an identification card may be substituted)

rows.source_ko: 나. 「후견등기에 관한 법률」 제15조제1항에 따른 등기사항증명서
rows.text_en: B. Certificate of registered matters pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Registration of Guardianship

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1항제4호에 따른 통합지원 관련기관 등의 업무담당자의 경우: 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 서류
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of a person in charge of duties at an integrated support-related institution, etc. pursuant to Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4: Documents classified according to each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 제1항제1호부터 제3호까지의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자로서 신청에 동의한 자의 주민등록증 등 신분증 사본
rows.text_en: a. A copy of the identification card, such as a resident registration card, of a person falling under any of subparagraphs 1 through 3 of Paragraph 1 who has consented to the application

rows.source_ko: 나. 통합지원 관련기관 등의 업무담당자임을 증명할 수 있는 서류(해당 서류의 제시로 갈음하거나 동일 기관에서 동일 업무담당자가 반복하여 신청하는 경우로서 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 인정하는 경우에는 생략할 수 있다)
rows.text_en: B. Documents proving that the applicant is a staff member at an integrated support-related institution, etc. (This may be substituted by the presentation of such documents, or omitted if the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head approves, provided that the same staff member at the same institution applies repeatedly)

rows.source_ko: 다. 가족관계기록사항에 관한 증명서 또는 제적등본(친족이 동의한 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: C. Certificate of family relationship records or extract of the family register (limited to cases where a relative has consented)

rows.source_ko: 라. 「후견등기에 관한 법률」 제15조제1항에 따른 등기사항증명서(후견인이 동의한 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: D. Certificate of registered matters pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Registration of Guardianship (limited to cases where the guardian has consented)

rows.source_ko: ③ 제14조제1항제1호에 따라 전문기관의 지정을 받은 국민건강보험공단은 제1항제1호부터 제3호까지의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자의 동의를 받아 국민건강보험공단이 관리ㆍ운영하는 정보시스템을 통해 통합지원의 신청을 지원할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The National Health Insurance Service, which has been designated as a specialized agency pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, may support applications for integrated support through an information system managed and operated by the National Health Insurance Service upon obtaining the consent of any person falling under any of Subparagraphs 1 through 3 of Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ④ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 법 제10조제2항에 따라 통합지원 신청을 직권으로 하는 경우의 통합지원 신청서의 서식은 별지 제1호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ④ Where a Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu applies for integrated support ex officio pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act, the application form for integrated support shall be in Form No. 1 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제2항부터 제4항까지에 따른 신청을 받으면 「민원 처리에 관한 법률」 제10조의2에 따른 본인정보 공동이용 또는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보 공동이용을 통하여 통합지원이 필요한 사람에 대한 다음 각 호의 사항을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 통합지원이 필요한 사람이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 해당 서류를 제출하도록 하여야 한다. <개정 2026. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Upon receiving an application pursuant to paragraphs 2 through 4, the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head shall verify the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs regarding a person requiring integrated support through the joint use of personal information pursuant to Article 10-2 of the Act on the Processing of Civil Petitions or the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the person requiring integrated support does not consent to the verification, they shall be required to submit the relevant documents. <Amended Mar. 20, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. 통합지원이 필요한 사람의 주민등록표 등본
rows.text_en: 1. Copy of Resident Registration Certificate of Person Requiring Integrated Support

rows.source_ko: 2. 통합지원이 필요한 사람의 장애인증명서(통합지원이 필요한 사람이 장애인인 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Certificate of disability for a person requiring integrated support (limited to cases where the person requiring integrated support is a person with a disability)

rows.source_ko: 3. 가족관계기록사항에 관한 증명서(제1항제2호의 친족이 신청한 경우로 한정한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Certificate of Family Relations Records (limited to cases where the application is made by a relative referred to in Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2)

rows.source_ko: 제8조(퇴원 또는 퇴소 여부 등의 통보) ① 법 제11조제1항제3호에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 기관 또는 시설”이란 「장애인복지법」 제58조제1항제1호에 따른 장애인 거주시설을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Notification of Discharge or Release, etc.) ① The term “institution or facility prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” in Article 11, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Act means a residential facility for persons with disabilities under Article 58, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1 of the Act on Welfare of Persons with Disabilities.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제11조제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 기관의 장은 퇴원하거나 퇴소하는 사람 본인의 성명ㆍ주소ㆍ연락처 등 보건복지부장관이 정하는 사항을 주소지 관할 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of an institution falling under any of the subparagraphs of Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall notify the mayor, county governor, or district head having jurisdiction over the address of the person being discharged or released of matters determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare, such as the person's name, address, and contact information .

rows.source_ko: 제9조(개인별지원계획의 수립 등) ① 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제13조에 따른 개인별지원계획(이하 “개인별지원계획”이라 한다)을 별지 제2호서식에 따라 수립하고 이를 신청인(법 제10조제2항에 따른 직권신청의 경우에는 통합지원 대상자를 말한다)에게 안내하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Preparation of Individual Support Plans, etc.) ① A Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu shall prepare an individual support plan pursuant to Article 13 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Individual Support Plan”) in Form No. 2 attached hereto and notify the applicant thereof (where the application was made ex officio pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act, the person eligible for integrated support).

rows.source_ko: ② 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 개인별지원계획을 수립하기 위하여 다음 각 호에 해당하는 사람으로 구성하는 통합지원회의를 운영할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor, County Governor, or District Head may operate an Integrated Support Council composed of persons falling under each of the following subparagraphs in order to establish individual support plans.

rows.source_ko: 1. 시ㆍ군ㆍ구(법 제21조에 따른 전담조직 등을 포함한다)의 업무담당자
rows.text_en: 1. Person in charge of duties at the City, County, or District ( including dedicated organizations, etc. pursuant to Article 21 of the Act )

rows.source_ko: 2. 관할 보건소 및 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동의 업무담당자
rows.text_en: 2. Officials in charge at the competent public health center and Eup, Myeon, or Dong

rows.source_ko: 3. 통합지원 관련기관의 업무담당자
rows.text_en: 3. Person in charge of duties at integrated support-related organizations

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제25조에 따른 전문기관(이하 “전문기관”이라 한다)의 업무담당자
rows.text_en: 4. Person in charge of duties at a specialized agency pursuant to Article 25 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Specialized Agency”)

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 지역 보건의료, 건강, 주거, 돌봄 분야의 전문성을 가진 것으로 인정하는 사람
rows.text_en: 5. Other persons recognized by the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head as possessing expertise in the fields of local public health care, health, housing, or care.

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제13조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 단서에 따라 다음 각 호에 따른 계획에 통합지원 대상자에 대한 보건의료등의 지원계획이 포괄적으로 작성되어 있을 경우 개인별지원계획을 대체할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Mayor, County Governor, or District Head may substitute an individual support plan if a support plan for health and medical care, etc. for integrated support recipients is comprehensively prepared in the plan pursuant to the proviso of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「노인장기요양보험법」 제23조제3항에 따른 통합재가서비스를 위한 계획
rows.text_en: 1. Plan for integrated home care services pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the Long-term Care Insurance Act for the Elderly

rows.source_ko: 2. 「사회보장급여의 이용ㆍ제공 및 수급권자 발굴에 관한 법률」 제15조에 따른 지원계획
rows.text_en: 2. Support plan pursuant to Article 15 of the Act on the Use and Provision of Social Security Benefits and the Identification of Beneficiaries

rows.source_ko: 제10조(통합지원 제공 상황 점검 등) ① 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제14조제4항에 따라 통합지원 제공 상황 및 통합지원 대상자의 상태변화를 개인별지원계획이 최초로 수립된 후 3개월 이내에 점검하여야 하고, 그 이후에는 6개월 이내의 범위에서 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 정하는 바에 따라 정기적으로 점검하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Inspection of the Status of Integrated Support Provision, etc.) ① A Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu shall inspect the status of integrated support provision and changes in the condition of recipients of integrated support pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 4 of the Act within three months after the individual support plan is first prepared, and thereafter conduct regular inspections at intervals of no more than six months, as determined by the relevant Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu.

rows.source_ko: ② 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따른 통합지원 제공 상황 및 통합지원 대상자의 상태변화에 대한 점검의 결과에 따라 개인별지원계획을 변경하거나 제공되는 통합지원 서비스를 조정하려는 경우 제9조제2항에 따른 통합지원회의의 의견을 들을 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If a Mayor, County Governor, or head of a Gu intends to amend the individual support plan or adjust the integrated support services provided based on the results of an inspection under Paragraph 1, the official may hear the opinions of the Integrated Support Council under Article 9, Paragraph 2.

rows.source_ko: Article 11 (Termination of Integrated Support) The Mayor, County Governor, or District Head may terminate integrated support in any of the following cases:
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Termination of Integrated Support) The Mayor, County Governor, or District Head may terminate integrated support in any of the following cases:

rows.source_ko: 1. Death of an integrated support recipient
rows.text_en: 1. Death of an integrated support recipient

rows.source_ko: 2. Cases where a recipient of integrated support is hospitalized at a medical institution or admitted to a facility and no longer requires integrated support
rows.text_en: 2. Where a recipient of integrated support is hospitalized at a medical institution or admitted to a facility and no longer requires integrated support

rows.source_ko: 3. Cases where complex support becomes unnecessary because some services within the integrated support are unnecessary
rows.text_en: 3. Cases where complex support becomes unnecessary because some services within the integrated support are unnecessary

rows.source_ko: 4. Cases where the integrated support recipient has explicitly expressed an intention to refuse receiving integrated support
rows.text_en: 4. Cases where the integrated support recipient has explicitly expressed an intention to refuse receiving integrated support

rows.source_ko: 5. Other cases where the Minister of Health and Welfare deems integrated support unnecessary
rows.text_en: 5. Other cases where the Minister of Health and Welfare deems integrated support unnecessary

rows.source_ko: Article 12 (Establishment and Operation of Integrated Support Information System, etc.) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall enable mayors, county governors, and district heads to perform integrated support duties pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 1 of the Act through the computerized information system pursuant to the same paragraph (hereinafter referred to as the “Integrated Support Information System”).
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Establishment and Operation of Integrated Support Information System, etc.) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall enable mayors, county governors, and district heads to perform integrated support duties pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 1 of the Act through the computerized information system pursuant to the same paragraph (hereinafter referred to as the “Integrated Support Information System”).

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare shall establish necessary measures, such as safety assurance measures for the protection of personal information, implementation of training, and designation of a personal information protection officer, in relation to the establishment and operation of the Integrated Support Information System.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare shall establish necessary measures, such as safety assurance measures for the protection of personal information, implementation of training, and designation of a personal information protection officer, in relation to the establishment and operation of the Integrated Support Information System.

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare entrusts the duties regarding the establishment and operation of the integrated support information system pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 4 of the Act to the Korea Social Security Information Service pursuant to Article 29 of the Act on the Use and Provision of Social Security Benefits and the Identification of Beneficiaries .
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare entrusts the duties regarding the establishment and operation of the integrated support information system pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 4 of the Act to the Korea Social Security Information Service pursuant to Article 29 of the Act on the Use and Provision of Social Security Benefits and the Identification of Beneficiaries .

rows.source_ko: Article 13 (Provision and Utilization of Information, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the Act , mayors, county governors, district heads, integrated support-related agencies, and specialized agencies may mutually request the provision of the following information for the smooth operation of integrated support services.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Provision and Utilization of Information, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the Act , mayors, county governors, district heads, integrated support-related agencies, and specialized agencies may mutually request the provision of the following information for the smooth operation of integrated support services.

rows.source_ko: 1. The following information pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the Act
rows.text_en: 1. The following information pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the Act

rows.source_ko: a. Name, residence, and contact information (including guardian's contact information) of the integrated support recipient required within the scope of duties under the individual support plan
rows.text_en: a. Name, residence, and contact information (including guardian's contact information) of the integrated support recipient required within the scope of duties under the individual support plan

rows.source_ko: B. Content of services that provide or require integrated support and the providers
rows.text_en: B. Content of services that provide or require integrated support and the providers

rows.source_ko: C. Results of investigation pursuant to Article 10 of the Act
rows.text_en: C. Results of investigation pursuant to Article 10 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. Status of service provision by integrated support-related organizations, provision period, name and contact information of the providing organization
rows.text_en: 2. Status of service provision by integrated support-related organizations, provision period, name and contact information of the providing organization

rows.source_ko: 3. Fact of discharge or release pursuant to Article 11 of the Act (limited to cases where the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head requests it to establish or modify an individual support plan)
rows.text_en: 3. Fact of discharge or release pursuant to Article 11 of the Act (limited to cases where the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head requests it to establish or modify an individual support plan)

rows.source_ko: 4. Changes in the Status and Service Requirements of Integrated Support Recipients
rows.text_en: 4. Changes in the Status and Service Requirements of Integrated Support Recipients

rows.source_ko: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Health and Welfare for the smooth integrated support operations of the institution requesting the provision of information within the individual support plan
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Health and Welfare for the smooth integrated support operations of the institution requesting the provision of information within the individual support plan

rows.source_ko: ② Mayors, county governors, district heads, integrated support-related agencies, and specialized agencies may request and provide information pursuant to each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 through the integrated support information system.
rows.text_en: ② Mayors, county governors, district heads, integrated support-related agencies, and specialized agencies may request and provide information pursuant to each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 through the integrated support information system.

rows.source_ko: Article 14 (Designation of Specialized Institutions, etc.) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall designatethe institutions listed in each of the following subparagraphs as specialized institutions pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Designation of Specialized Institutions, etc.) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall designate the institutions specified in the following subparagraphs as specialized institutions pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 1. National Health Insurance Service pursuant to the National Health Insurance Act
rows.text_en: 1. National Health Insurance Service pursuant to the National Health Insurance Act

rows.source_ko: 2. National Pension Service pursuant to the National Pension Act
rows.text_en: 2. National Pension Service pursuant to the National Pension Act

rows.source_ko: 3. Central and municipal/provincial social service centers pursuant to the Act on Support for Social Services and Establishment and Operation of Social Service Agencies
rows.text_en: 3. Central and municipal/provincial social service centers pursuant to the Act on Support for Social Services and Establishment and Operation of Social Service Agencies

rows.source_ko: 4. Korea Institute for the Development of the Disabled pursuant to the Welfare of Persons with Disabilities Act
rows.text_en: 4. Korea Institute for the Development of the Disabled pursuant to the Welfare of Persons with Disabilities Act

rows.source_ko: ② In Article 25, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the Act , “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to matters concerning the development and provision of models for local customized integrated support services, etc., necessary for local residents by local governments.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 25, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5 of the Act , “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to matters concerning the development and provision of models for local customized integrated support services, etc., necessary for local residents by local governments.

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall issue a designation certificate in the form of Annex 3 to the specialized institution pursuant to Paragraph 1 .
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall issue a designation certificate in the form of Annex 3 to the specialized institution pursuant to Paragraph 1 .

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Health and Welfare Decree No. 1137, Dec. 9, 2025>

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on March 27, 2026.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Rule shall enter into force on March 27, 2026.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Preparatory Acts for Designation of Specialized Institutions, etc.)  ① Even before the enforcement of this Rule, the Minister of Health and Welfare may designate the institutions listed in each subparagraph of Article 14, Paragraph 1 as specialized institutions or perform preparatory acts necessary for such designation pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Preparatory Acts for Designation of Specialized Institutions, etc.)  ① Even before the enforcement of this Rule, the Minister of Health and Welfare may designate the institutions listed in each subparagraph of Article 14, Paragraph 1 as specialized institutions or perform preparatory acts necessary for such designation pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 1 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: ② An institution designated as a specialized institution pursuant to Paragraph 1 may take necessary preparatory actions for the performance of its duties even before the enforcement of this Rule.
rows.text_en: ② An institution designated as a specialized institution pursuant to Paragraph 1 may take necessary preparatory actions for the performance of its duties even before the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Health and Welfare Decree No. 1161, Mar. 20, 2026>

rows.text_en: This Rule shall enter into force on March 27, 2026.
